reasonDialog.descReincludeTeam: This team's results will count toward rankings again for this tournament. The change is written to the audit log with your reason.
reasonDialog.descReincludePlayer: This player's results will count toward rankings again for this tournament. The change is written to the audit log with your reason.
reasonDialog.descDisable: Turning counting off removes these results from every affected ranking calculation. The change is written to the audit log with your reason.
